chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, raising it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The woman does not give birth in less than six months.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum duration of pregnancy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the minimum gestation period as six months, a foundational ruling in Shia jurisprudence for determining paternity and the waiting period (iddah) of women. It reflects the biological understanding accepted by the Imams, serving as a key criterion in legal cases where birth occurs shortly after separation or death.
